title: UGC Ad Strategist brief.json
description: The single artifact ugc-ad-strategist produces and ugc-video-producer consumes. One claim per ad.

avatar.description: Who the ad talks to, in their own words (from voice-of-customer research).

customer_words.description: verbatim phrases pulled from VoC research

awareness_stage.description: Schwartz awareness stage; dictates hook style and proof depth.

market_sophistication.description: 1=first to market claim, 5=mechanism/identity play. Dictates how much the hook must differentiate.

single_claim.description: THE one claim the whole ad supports. Capability/process claim, never an income guarantee.

angle.description: The strategic angle that carries the claim.

proof_object.description: The load-bearing proof shown on screen (real app, real pages, real result).

message_match.description: The exact line that mirrors the landing page, for ad->LP congruence.

base_still_prompt.description: ONE persona-seed prompt for the spokesperson, realism-directive compliant. Producer generates the identity anchor from this.

clips.description: Ordered beat sheet. Each clip is one 6-10s Grok shot. ~24-28 spoken words per 10s.

seconds.description: Grok renders ONLY 6s or 10s. Size dialogue to fit: ~14-16 words @6s, ~24-28 @10s (QA Bank A1).

dialogue.description: Exact spoken line. First-person past-tense testimonial. Filler words for realism.

emotion.description: Delivery direction -> feeds the Grok animation prompt.

action.description: Physical action/gesture/camera note. LOCKED-OFF camera when a screen must stay pinnable.

grok_prompt.description: Ready-to-paste Grok image_to_video prompt for this clip.

screen_asset.description: Present only for digital-product proof clips. Hands to ugc-device-screen.

pdf.description: abs path to the real PDF/app to pin on the device

driven_by.description: screen only moves when the avatar drives it or a video plays

product_shot.description: Physical product anchor for a clip (e.g. holding the real hardcover). Producer builds a photoreal hardcover mockup from the REAL cover via book_mockup.py, then anchors it (never lets Grok invent the cover).

cover_image.description: abs path to the REAL cover art (truthful source for the mockup), e.g. ~/code/aimastery-salespage/covers/ai-mastery-vol1.png

staging.description: how the physical book sits in the shot

scarcity.description: the verified scarcity status this shot supports, e.g. 'hardcopy_sold_out'. Only set when TRUE — false scarcity fails FTC/Meta and breaks house style.

hooks.description: 6 swappable hook variants, body+CTA held constant. <2.5s spoken, <25 words.

category.description: speed_flex / skeptic_reversal / contrast / confession / cold_open / message_match

platform_note.description: e.g. 'TikTok/organic only — second-person attribute callout warns on Meta'

platform_cuts.description: Line swaps per platform/spend type. Paid speaks price (FTC); organic uses DM CTA.

persistent_disclaimer.description: e.g. 'My results. Results vary.' Spoken + on-screen.

id.description: ElevenLabs voice id. Default Brittney kPzsL2i3teMYv0FxEYQ6

utm_map.description: UTM template per platform; <hook-id> placeholder filled per variant.

market_winners.description: Ranked active competitor/niche ads from ad_library_scout (longevity heuristic). Informs angle + differentiation.
